summary: Set hub_storage_backend=s3 with hub_s3_access_key, hub_s3_secret_key and hub_s3_bucket_name (bucket must exist); extra options go in hub_s3_extra_settings.
questions: How do I configure S3 storage for automation hub?
How do I set the S3 region for hub?

answer_card.title: Hub on Amazon S3
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[all:vars]
hub_storage_backend=s3
hub_s3_access_key=<access_key>
hub_s3_secret_key=<secret_key>
hub_s3_bucket_name=<bucket_name>
hub_s3_extra_settings={'AWS_S3_REGION_NAME': 'eu-south-1'}
```
The bucket must exist before installing.
